parameters.query:
SELECT c.id as case_id, c.project_id, c.row_version as case_version, c.recommendation, p.currency, p.manager_email, p.client_email, p.repo_owner, p.repo_name
FROM scopeledger.cases c
JOIN scopeledger.projects p ON p.id = c.project_id
WHERE c.id = $1::uuid;

WITH draft AS (
  SELECT proposal_id, proposal_version, payload_hash
  FROM scopeledger.create_proposal_draft(
    $1::uuid,
    $2::jsonb,
    now() + interval '72 hours'
  )
),
challenge AS (
  SELECT c.challenge_id, c.one_time_code
  FROM draft d,
  LATERAL scopeledger.issue_auth_challenge($3::uuid, d.proposal_id, 'manager', 'manager_publish', '127.0.0.1') c
),
verified AS (
  SELECT v.review_token
  FROM challenge c,
  LATERAL scopeledger.verify_auth_challenge(c.challenge_id, c.one_time_code) v
)
SELECT p.proposal_id, p.proposal_version, p.payload_hash, p.expires_at
FROM draft d, verified v,
LATERAL scopeledger.publish_proposal(v.review_token, d.proposal_id, $4::bigint, 'manager-publish-flow') p;
